name: Arkansas
agencyName: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration, Office of Motor Vehicle / Driver Services

gdl.permitHoldingPeriod: 6 months clean record before next stage
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 11 p.m.-4 a.m. (intermediate license) unless with a licensed adult 21+, or for work/school/church/emergency
gdl.passengerLimits: Intermediate drivers may not carry more than one passenger under 21 who is not a family member

requiredDocuments: Proof of legal presence (e.g. U.S. birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Proof of identity (e.g. current license/ID, school ID, or marriage certificate)
Two proofs of Arkansas residency (e.g. utility bill, pay stub, bank statement)
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID requires proof of legal presence, one proof of identity, a Social Security card, and two proofs of Arkansas residency. Use the state's online REAL ID quiz to confirm documents before visiting a Revenue Office.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 acuity (typical standard; exact threshold not published on the referenced pages)

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 14 or more points triggers a mandatory hearing; failure to appear leads to suspension (10 points draws a warning)
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane, or slow down if you cannot, for stopped emergency, law-enforcement, and tow/utility vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 25 mph when posted/flashing (varies by posted sign)
